remote_wechat_help_full.other:
📋 TeamBuddy WeChat channel commands:

[Tasks]

• /task or /task -r: list active tasks

• /task -a: list all tasks

• /task -f: list done tasks

• /task -e: list blocked tasks

• @: list all tasks

[Task actions]

• @<task-id>: switch to that task

• @<task-id> <message>: send a message to that task

• /ti or /task-info -id=<task>: show task details (friendly id = short id or list index)

• /ct or /create-task -t=<title> [-d=<desc>] [-w=<dir>] [-pid=<project index>] [-plid=<pipeline index>] [-egid=<expert group index>] [-em=<mode>] [-et=<cli>] [-emdl=<model>]: create a local task (many parameters, mainly used by the CLI fallback)

• /ctt or /create-team-task -tid=<local task short id> -ttid=<my-work ttid> [-t=<title>]: create a team work that inherits the local task's config (project / pipeline / sub-projects / work dirs / per-step CLI & model). This is the most common way to create a task; copy the <ttid> number from /tt output for -ttid.

• /n -id=<task>: advance to the next step. On the last step, replies "this is already the last step" without completing the task.

[Direct messages]

• Just send a message: routed to the currently bound task

[Session control]

• /exit or /q or 退出: leave the current task

• /c or /cancel or 取消: cancel the current task (two-step confirm, -f to skip)

• /r or /resume or 继续: resume the current task (two-step confirm, -f to skip)

• /d or /done or 完成: mark the current task done and leave (two-step confirm, -f to skip)

[Operate the local client]

• /tt or /teamstask: list my work (cloud)

• /pro or /projects: list local projects

• /pls or /pipelines: list pipelines (local + cached cloud)

• /egs or /expert-groups: list expert groups (local + cached cloud)

• /clis or /cli-discovery: list installed CLIs

• /clim or /cli-models -cid=<N>: list models for the given CLI

• /vcl or /vibecodinglist or /codex-capability: list Vibe Coding tools

• /swm or /switch-model -id=<task> [-cid=<N>] (-mid=<N> | -emdl=<model name>): switch CLI / model (with -mid alone the task's current CLI is kept; the session is not stopped)

• /swcli or /switch-cli -id=<task> -cid=<N> (-mid=<N> | -emdl=<model name>): switch CLI / model

• /swr or /switch-run -t=<cli|pls|egs|vcl> -id=<task> [-plid=<N>] [-egid=<N>] [-vid=<N>]: switch execution mode (archive + rebuild)

[Misc]

• /help or /h: show this help

[Tasks]

• /task or /task -r: list active tasks

• /task -a: list all tasks

• /task -f: list done tasks

• /task -e: list blocked tasks

• @: list all tasks

[Task actions]

• @<task-id>: switch to that task

• @<task-id> <message>: send a message to that task

• /ti or /task-info -id=<task>: show task details (friendly id = short id or list index)

• /ct or /create-task -t=<title> [-d=<desc>] [-w=<dir>] [-pid=<project index>] [-plid=<pipeline index>] [-egid=<expert group index>] [-em=<mode>] [-et=<cli>] [-emdl=<model>]: create a local task (many parameters, mainly used by the CLI fallback)

• /ctt or /create-team-task -tid=<local task short id> -ttid=<my-work ttid> [-t=<title>]: create a team work that inherits the local task's config (project / pipeline / sub-projects / work dirs / per-step CLI & model). This is the most common way to create a task; copy the <ttid> number from /tt output for -ttid.

• /n -id=<task>: advance to the next step. On the last step, replies "this is already the last step" without completing the task.

[Direct messages]

• Just send a message: routed to the currently bound task

[Session control]

• /exit or /q or 退出: leave the current task

• /c or /cancel or 取消: cancel the current task (two-step confirm, -f to skip)

• /r or /resume or 继续: resume the current task (two-step confirm, -f to skip)

• /d or /done or 完成: mark the current task done and leave (two-step confirm, -f to skip)

[Operate the local client]

• /tt or /teamstask: list my work (cloud)

• /pro or /projects: list local projects

• /pls or /pipelines: list pipelines (local + cached cloud)

• /egs or /expert-groups: list expert groups (local + cached cloud)

• /clis or /cli-discovery: list installed CLIs

• /clim or /cli-models -cid=<N>: list models for the given CLI

• /vcl or /vibecodinglist or /codex-capability: list Vibe Coding tools

• /swm or /switch-model -id=<task> [-cid=<N>] (-mid=<N> | -emdl=<model name>): switch CLI / model (with -mid alone the task's current CLI is kept; the session is not stopped)

• /swcli or /switch-cli -id=<task> -cid=<N> (-mid=<N> | -emdl=<model name>): switch CLI / model

• /swr or /switch-run -t=<cli|pls|egs|vcl> -id=<task> [-plid=<N>] [-egid=<N>] [-vid=<N>]: switch execution mode (archive + rebuild)

[Misc]

• /help or /h: show this help
